name: Sample Pages 11 — Employment Detail Side Panel (Summary)
source: User-provided screenshot export from Figma (Sample Side-Panel Modal Detail - 1). Node ID not captured.
description: Employee/candidate employment detail opened as a wide right-anchored side panel (Panel, MultiCard) over a scrimmed base page. Panel header: candidate switcher dropdown + prev/next buttons + collapse + close. Summary bar: avatar + full name + status/info chips. Body: two columns — left Employment History tree (company > contract > version cards), right contract detail card with a 6-step approval stage stepper, underline tabs and a summary grid of icon+label/value blocks.

shell.note: Base page remains visible at the left under a scrim overlay (per layout-05 Panel spec). Sidebar/app-bar of the base page are behind the scrim.

panel-header.description: Panel top bar. Left: record switcher — Dropdown input showing the current candidate name + prev/next icon buttons (Outlined, chevron-left / chevron-right). Right: collapse-to-right icon button + close X icon button.

summary-bar.description: Identity strip on a white card. Avatar (component: avatar) + full name (text-styles.bold.body-lg, system.text-head) + chip row: status-chip Success 'Active Employee', then neutral info chips with leading icons: 'ID: EL-CV2030999', 'Current: PT Huawei Device', 'Total: 0 Years 5 Months 1 Days' (chip style Neutral).

components.note: Info chips: ID / Current / Total, each with leading icon

detail-columns.description: Two-column body on system.surface-strong canvas, gap spacing.standard.md. Left: 370px Employment History card. Right: flexible contract detail card.

employment-history.description: History tree card. Header: 'Employment History' (text-styles.bold.body-md) + collapse icon button. Tree: company node (radio-style active dot brand.brand + company name, collapsible chevron) > contract group card (system.surface-soft bg: folder icon + 'Fixed-Term (PKWT)' + 'Ref: 638/PKWT-PTES/001/VI/2024' in text-styles.regular.label-sm system.text-mute) > version cards linked by a dotted timeline line. Version card anatomy: version chip ('V2 · Amend' — chip Neutral SM) + right badge ('Current' status-chip Success / 'Previous' chip Neutral); contract number (text-styles.bold.body-sm, system.text-head); icon rows: date range with '(Ongoing)' in semantic.success or '(Ended)' in semantic.error, role name, salary 'IDR 13.000.000' (text-styles.regular.body-sm, system.text-body). Selected version card: stroke.regular border brand.brand. Unselected: stroke.thin system.border-soft.

contract-detail.description: Contract detail card. Header row: contract number 'PTES.018/05-PTES/41747/XI/24' (text-styles.bold.body-md, system.text-head) + 'Actions' split button (Outlined) right. Below: approval stage stepper (custom), then underline tabs, then tab content.

stage-stepper.description: CUSTOM ELEMENT — horizontal 6-step progress stepper: numbered circles (1-6) connected by a line, labels beneath (KA REVIEW, KAM, HOD, KA SEND, CANDIDATE, ACTIVE). Completed/current steps: circle bg brand.brand, number neutral.pure-white, label brand.brand (text-styles.bold.label-sm), connector brand.brand. Upcoming steps: circle bg system.surface-strong, number system.text-mute, label system.text-mute (text-styles.regular.label-sm), connector system.border-medium. In this view all 6 stages are completed (contract fully active).

tab-summary.description: Two-column grid of labelled value blocks separated by soft divider rows. Each block: leading icon in a tonal square (icon-button Tonal look), label above (text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-mute), value below (text-styles.bold.body-sm, system.text-head). Chip values use status-chip / chip components.

customElementsRegistry.panel-detail-header: Candidate switcher dropdown + prev/next outlined icon buttons left; collapse + close right. Border-bottom: system.border-soft.
customElementsRegistry.candidate-summary-bar: Avatar + name + status-chip Success + neutral info chips (ID / Current / Total).
customElementsRegistry.employment-detail-columns: Two-column: 370px history tree card + flexible contract detail card on system.surface-strong canvas.
customElementsRegistry.employment-history-tree: Company node > contract group (surface-soft) > version cards on dotted timeline. Selected version: brand.brand border. Ongoing: semantic.success; Ended: semantic.error.
customElementsRegistry.approval-stage-stepper: 6 numbered circle steps + connector line. Done/current: brand.brand circle + label. Upcoming: system.surface-strong circle, system.text-mute label.

geometry.basis: 1366x768 design canvas; measured on 2732x1536 @2x real shots
